article.linkText: Nebraska hosts No. 16 Ohio State in Big Ten matchup
article.story: No. 16 Ohio State (7-3) at Nebraska (6-4), Nov. 21 at 12 p.m. EST. Opening Line: Ohio State by 3. Against the spread: Ohio State 5-5, Nebraska 7-3. How to watch: FOX Key stats Ohio State Offense Overall: 458 yards per game (15th in FBS) Passing: 308.3 yards per game (9th) Rushing: 149.7 yards per game (79th) Scoring: 34.9 points per game (20th) Ohio State Defense Overall: 286.1 yards per game (13th in FBS) Passing: 193.4 yards per game (40th) Rushing: 92.7 yards per game (12th) Scoring: 18.4 points per game (19th) Nebraska Offense Overall: 425.4 yards per game (31st in FBS) Passing: 238.2 yards per game (50th) Rushing: 187.2 yards per game (32nd) Scoring: 30.3 points per game (48th) Nebraska Defense Overall: 268.5 yards per game (6th in FBS) Passing: 177.1 yards per game (18th) Rushing: 91.4 yards per game (11th) Scoring: 14.9 points per game (10th) Ohio State ranks 87th in defensive third down percentage, allowing opponents to convert 39.7% of the time. Nebraska ranks 14th on offense, converting on 47.4% of third downs. Nebraska is 118th in the FBS averaging 68.7 penalty yards per game, compared to Ohio State's 59th-ranked 52.9 per-game average. Ohio State is 113th in FBS in red zone defense, allowing opponents to score on 89.3% of trips. Nebraska's red zone offense ranks 27th, scoring on 90.9% of red zone opportunities. Both teams rank high in time of possession. Ohio State is 10th in the FBS with an average time of possession of 32:42, while Nebraska's 8th-ranked average is 32:47. Team leaders Ohio State Passing: Julian Sayin, 2,007 yards, 19 TDs, 4 INTs, 68.2 completion percentage Rushing: Bo Jackson, 799 yards on 159 carries, 7 TDs Receiving: Jeremiah Smith, 1,317 yards on 80 catches, 15 TDs Nebraska Passing: Anthony Colandrea, 2,297 yards, 18 TDs, 7 INTs, 63.4 completion percentage Rushing: Jamal Rule, 635 yards on 110 carries, 5 TDs Receiving: Kwazi Gilmer, 603 yards on 46 catches, 7 TDs Last game Ohio State defeated Northwestern 28-19 on Nov. 14. Luke Fahey passed for 201 yards on 21-of-32 attempts (65.6%) with three touchdowns and one interception. Jackson carried the ball 20 times for 114 yards and scored one touchdown, adding two receptions for 20 yards. Smith put up 117 yards on 11 catches with one touchdown. Nebraska defeated Rutgers 31-0 on Nov. 14. Colandrea led Nebraska with 188 yards on 15-of-22 passing (68.2%) for two touchdowns and no interceptions. He also carried the ball nine times for 66 yards and one rushing touchdown. Rule carried the ball 22 times for 103 yards, adding one reception for two yards. Carter Nelson recorded 53 yards on two catches with one touchdown. Next game Ohio State hosts Michigan on Nov. 28. Nebraska plays at No. 13 Iowa on Nov. 27.
